'''May 2001 Ottawa tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Ottawa, Ontario on 27 May 2001. [[Martin Leblanc]] won it. It is known from Thomas Dowling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2380">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-27-ottawa-canada-27-5-01d2380/ ottawa-canada-27-5-01], DeckTech (Thomas "COTEB" Dowling, 27 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-27-ottawa-canada-27-5-01d2380/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Ottawa, Ontario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Martin Leblanc]]
